services.desc: This camp takes our youngest explorers on a week-long adventure interacting with animals, daily ocean-themed crafts, activities and games, and a treasure hunt! Each day will bring a new theme with fun-filled activities! Join us for a fin-tastic week at this half-day or full-day camp! To keep camp exciting, we offer alternating weekly curriculums based on whether the session is an odd or even number. services.name: Guided Snorkel Tour
services.desc: Join our semi-private guided snorkel tours and explore the stunning marine life of Shaw’s Cove! Meet at the beach where your expert guide will lead you through Southern California’s beautiful kelp forests. Enjoy 45 minutes in the water as our guide introduces you to the beauty of Southern California’s kelp forests and their marine life. All gear provided-just bring your sense of adventure! Recommended for ages six and up. All guests must be able to swim in the ocean. Guests must secure their own transportation to Shaw’s Cove. blurb: The Ocean Institute is a non-profit ocean education center in Dana Point Harbor where marine science and maritime history come to life. Visit our waterfront campus to explore Southern California’s marine life and rich maritime heritage through interactive exhibits and hands-on experiences for all ages.
